title: If only
goal: Talk about dreams and big life choices, say what you would do if things were different, what you would have done if you'd known, what you should have done, and what you wish.
intro:
Late at night on a roof in Kathmandu, the conversation turns to the big questions: go abroad or stay? quit the job? what if I'd taken that scholarship? This unit gives you the language of **dreams, wishes and regrets**.

The grammar is the **unreal conditional**. In unit 19 you learned the real 'if' (पानी पर्‍यो भने 'if it rains') and met 'if I had known, I would have come'. Now you'll use the 'would' form **-थ्यो** for things that aren't true now (म तिमी **भए** त्यसो **गर्दिनथेँ** 'if I were you, I wouldn't do that'), talk about regrets (मैले भन्नु**पर्ने थियो** 'I should have said'), and make wishes with **भए हुन्थ्यो** 'if only…, I wish…'.

vocab.en: wish, longing; something you'd love to do
vocab.note: मलाई … गर्ने रहर छ "I'd love to …". Softer and more personal than इच्छा. रहरले "for fun, because I wanted to".
The everyday word. The formal/written word is जीवन (jiban).
Experiencer pattern: मलाई पछुतो लाग्यो "I regretted it".
पछि पछुताउनुभन्दा… "rather than regretting it later…".
मौका पाउनु "to get a chance"; मौका छोप्नु "to seize the chance".

vocab.en: to lose, miss (a chance, a job, someone)
vocab.note: For losing things you carry, use हराउनु.
भाग्यले "luckily, by luck"; भाग्यमानी "lucky". Many people say भाग्यमा जे छ, त्यही हुन्छ "what's in your fate will happen".
चिट्ठा पर्नु "to win the lottery". In Nepal, the US green-card lottery is famous: डिभी पर्‍यो "he won the DV".

vocab.en: to leave, quit, give up; to let go
vocab.note: जागिर छोड्नु "to quit a job"; चुरोट छोड्नु "to give up smoking".
Formal: व्यवसाय (byabasāya). आफ्नै बिजनेस "your own business".

vocab.en: to open; to start (a shop, business); to take off (shoes)

vocab.note: पढाइ सकियो "I've finished my studies"; पढाइ छोड्नु "to drop out".
In speech often स्कलरसिप.

vocab.en: the Public Service Commission (exam for government jobs)
vocab.note: लोक सेवाको तयारी "studying for the civil-service exam" — a whole way of life for many young Nepalis.
For "live (somewhere)" use बस्नु.
के फरक पर्छ? "what difference does it make?"
असम्भव "impossible".
Experiencer: मलाई आँट आएन "I didn't have the nerve"; आँट गर्नु "to dare".
With -न: बोल्न डराउनु "to be scared to speak". Compare मलाई डर लाग्छ (unit 14).
बुढेसकालमा "in old age".
रहर पूरा हुनु "(a dream) to come true"; पूरा गर्नु "to complete, fulfil".
The "would" form of हुनु. राम्रो हुन्थ्यो "it would be good"; … भए हुन्थ्यो "I wish …".
Emphatic form of पहिले.

phrases.en: If I were you, I wouldn't do that.
What would you do if you got ten million rupees?
It's done — what can you do?
phrases.note: The classic Nepali shrug. Also just के गर्ने!

phrases.native: कुनै दिन म आफ्नै बिजनेस खोल्छु।
phrases.roman: kunai din ma āphnai bijnes kholchhu.
phrases.en: One day I'll start my own business.

grammar.title: If I were…, I'd…: the 'would' form -थ्यो
grammar.body:
For things that are **not true now** — dreams, advice, imagined situations — Nepali uses:

**if-clause in -ए (or -एको भए)** + **result in the 'would' form**

मसँग पैसा **भए** म घर **किन्थेँ** — 'If I had money, I'd buy a house.'
म तिमी **भए** त्यसो **गर्दिनथेँ** — 'If I were you, I wouldn't do that.'

The 'would' form is the same as the past habitual ('used to'): stem + **-थ्-** + ending. For गर्नु:

म **गर्थेँ** · हामी **गर्थ्यौँ** · तिमी **गर्थ्यौ** · ऊ **गर्थ्यो** (she **गर्थी**) · उनी/उनीहरू **गर्थे** · तपाईं **गर्नुहुन्थ्यो**

Vowel stems add -न्- or ँ: **जान्थेँ, खान्थेँ, आउँथेँ, हुन्थ्यो**.

**Negative**: म **गर्दिनथेँ** · तिमी **गर्दैनथ्यौ** · ऊ **गर्दैनथ्यो** · उनीहरू **गर्दैनथे** · तपाईं **गर्नुहुन्नथ्यो**.

**Real or unreal?** Compare the two 'if's:
- पैसा **भयो भने** किन्छु — 'If I get the money, I'll buy it' (a real possibility, unit 19).
- पैसा **भए** **किन्थेँ** — 'If I had the money, I'd buy it' (but I don't).
It's the **-थ्यो** result that makes it a daydream; the -ए if-clause on its own can be either.

The set phrase **म तिमी भए** / **म तपाईं भए** 'if I were you' is how Nepalis give advice. **म भए** 'if it were me' is shorter and very common.

examples.native: मसँग समय भए म तिमीसँग जान्थेँ।
examples.roman: masaṃga samaya bhae ma timisaṃga jāntheṃ.
examples.en: If I had time, I'd go with you.

examples.native: म धनी भए आमाबुबालाई संसार घुमाउँथेँ।
examples.roman: ma dhani bhae āmābubālāi sansār ghumāuntheṃ.
examples.en: If I were rich, I'd take my parents round the world.
If I were you, I'd go to the doctor.

examples.native: उसलाई नेपाली आए ऊ यहीँ काम गर्थ्यो।
examples.roman: usalāi nepāli āe u yahiṃ kām garthyo.
examples.en: If he knew Nepali, he'd work here.

examples.native: म भए यति महँगो होटलमा बस्दिनथेँ।
examples.roman: ma bhae yati mahaṃgo hoṭalmā basdinatheṃ.
examples.en: If it were me, I wouldn't stay in such an expensive hotel.

grammar.title: Regrets: 'if I had…', 'I should have…'
grammar.body:
**If I had…, I would have…** — you met this in unit 19: the if-clause in **-एको भए**, the result in **-ने थियो** (थिएँ, थियौ, थियो, थिए, हुनुहुन्थ्यो):

थाहा **भएको भए** म **आउने थिएँ** — 'If I'd known, I'd have come.'
Negative result: आउने **थिइनँ** 'I wouldn't have come' (थिइनँ, थिएनौ, थिएन, थिएनन्).

In speech the 'would' form -थ्यो also works here — थाहा भएको भए म **आउँथेँ** — and you can mix times: 'if I had…(then), I would be…(now)':
त्यो जागिर **लिएको भए** अहिले म दुबईमा **हुन्थेँ** — 'If I'd taken that job, I'd be in Dubai now.'

**I should have…** — verb-**नुपर्ने थियो** (lit. 'it was going to be necessary'). The doer usually takes **-ले**:
मैले पहिल्यै **भन्नुपर्ने थियो** — 'I should have said so earlier.'
तिमीले मलाई **सोध्नुपर्ने थियो** — 'You should have asked me.'

**I shouldn't have…** — verb-**नु हुँदैनथ्यो** 'it wasn't right to…':
मैले त्यसो **भन्नु हुँदैनथ्यो** — 'I shouldn't have said that.'

**Feeling regret** is an experiencer construction: **मलाई पछुतो लाग्यो / लागेको छ** 'I regret it'. Or the verb: म **पछुताएँ** 'I regretted it'. And the classic Nepali way to close the subject: **भइसक्यो, अब के गर्ने?** 'It's done — what can you do?'

examples.native: मैले त्यो छात्रवृत्ति लिएको भए अहिले जापानमा हुन्थेँ।
examples.roman: maile tyo chhātrabritti lieko bhae ahile Jāpānmā huntheṃ.
examples.en: If I'd taken that scholarship, I'd be in Japan now.

examples.native: बस नछुटेको भए म समयमै पुग्ने थिएँ।
examples.roman: bas nachhuṭeko bhae ma samayamai pugne thieṃ.
examples.en: If I hadn't missed the bus, I'd have arrived on time.
I should have asked him earlier.
I shouldn't have said that in anger.

examples.native: पढाइ छोडेकोमा उसलाई अहिले पछुतो लाग्छ।
examples.roman: paḍhāi chhoḍekomā usalāi ahile pachhuto lāgchha.
examples.en: He regrets dropping out of his studies now.

grammar.title: I wish…: भए हुन्थ्यो
grammar.body:
Nepali makes wishes with an 'if' clause and **हुन्थ्यो** 'it would be (good)' — literally 'if X, it would be…':

**About now or the future** — verb in **-ए** + हुन्थ्यो:
तिमी यहाँ **भए हुन्थ्यो** — 'I wish you were here.'
आज बिदा **भए हुन्थ्यो** — 'I wish today were a holiday.'
तिमी पनि **आए हुन्थ्यो** — 'It'd be nice if you came too.'
पानी **नपरे हुन्थ्यो** — 'I hope it doesn't rain' (negative न- + -ए).

**About the past (regret)** — verb in **-एको भए** + हुन्थ्यो:
म पनि **गएको भए हुन्थ्यो** — 'I wish I'd gone too.'
मैले त्यो **नभनेको भए हुन्थ्यो** — 'I wish I hadn't said that.'

You can say the whole thing with just the if-clause and a sigh: **पहिल्यै थाहा भएको भए!** 'If only I'd known!' — the 'would' part is understood.

**Dreams for the future** use other patterns you know: **मलाई … गर्ने रहर छ** 'I'd love to…', **मेरो सपना … हो**, **कुनै दिन** + future 'one day I'll…'. When a dream comes true: **रहर पूरा भयो**.

examples.en: I wish I didn't have to go to the office today.

examples.native: मसँग पनि यस्तो गाडी भए हुन्थ्यो।
examples.roman: masaṃga pani yasto gāḍi bhae hunthyo.
examples.en: I wish I had a car like this too.

examples.native: मैले नेपाली अझ चाँडो सिकेको भए हुन्थ्यो।
examples.roman: maile nepāli ajha chāṃḍo sikeko bhae hunthyo.
examples.en: I wish I'd learned Nepali sooner.

examples.native: मलाई एक पटक मुस्ताङ जाने रहर छ।
examples.roman: malāi ek paṭak Mustāṅ jāne rahar chha.
examples.en: I'd love to go to Mustang one day.

dialogue.title: Stay or go?
dialogue.setting: Late evening on a roof terrace in Kirtipur. Bikash, who works at a bank, and his old college friend Rojina are drinking tea.

lines.speaker: Rojina
lines.native: के सोचिरहेको? एकदम चुपचाप छौ त।
lines.roman: ke sochiraheko? ekdam chupchāp chhau ta.
lines.en: What are you thinking about? You're really quiet.

lines.speaker: Bikash
lines.native: खै यार, अस्ट्रेलिया जाऊँ कि नजाऊँ भनेर सोच्दै छु।
lines.roman: khai yār, Asṭreliyā jāuṃ ki najāuṃ bhanera sochdai chhu.
lines.en: Dunno, mate. I'm trying to decide whether to go to Australia or not.

lines.speaker: Rojina
lines.native: तिमी त बैंकमा राम्रो जागिर गर्दै छौ नि।
lines.roman: timi ta baiṅkmā rāmro jāgir gardai chhau ni.
lines.en: But you've got a good job at the bank.

lines.speaker: Bikash
lines.native: हो, तर तलबले के पुग्छ र? पैसा भए म आफ्नै बिजनेस खोल्थेँ।
lines.roman: ho, tara talabale ke pugchha ra? paisā bhae ma āphnai bijnes kholtheṃ.
lines.en: Sure, but how far does a salary go? If I had money, I'd start my own business.

lines.speaker: Rojina
lines.native: म तिमी भए यहीँ बस्थेँ। आमाबुबा पनि यहीँ हुनुहुन्छ।
lines.roman: ma timi bhae yahiṃ bastheṃ. āmābubā pani yahiṃ hunuhunchha.
lines.en: If I were you, I'd stay here. Your parents are here too.

lines.speaker: Bikash
lines.native: तिमीलाई के थाहा? तिमी त पोहोर छात्रवृत्ति पाएर पनि गइनौ।
lines.roman: timilāi ke thāhā? timi ta pohor chhātrabritti pāera pani gainau.
lines.en: What would you know? You got a scholarship last year and still didn't go.

lines.speaker: Rojina
lines.native: त्यही त! गएको भए अहिले जापानमा हुन्थेँ होला। कहिलेकाहीँ पछुतो लाग्छ।
lines.roman: tyahi ta! gaeko bhae ahile Jāpānmā huntheṃ holā. kahilekāhiṃ pachhuto lāgchha.
lines.en: Exactly! If I'd gone, I'd probably be in Japan now. Sometimes I regret it.

lines.speaker: Rojina
lines.native: आँट आएन यार। आमा बिरामी हुनुहुन्थ्यो, छोडेर जान मन लागेन।
lines.roman: āṃṭ āena yār. āmā birāmi hunuhunthyo, chhoḍera jāna man lāgena.
lines.en: I didn't have the guts. Mum was ill; I didn't want to leave her.

lines.speaker: Bikash
lines.native: बुझेँ। तर अहिले फेरि मौका आयो भने?
lines.roman: bujheṃ. tara ahile pheri maukā āyo bhane?
lines.en: I get it. But what if the chance came up again now?

lines.speaker: Rojina
lines.native: त्यसो भए त जान्थेँ होला… खै, थाहा छैन। तिमी चाहिँ?
lines.roman: tyaso bhae ta jāntheṃ holā… khai, thāhā chhaina. timi chāhiṃ?
lines.en: Then I'd probably go… I don't know. What about you?

lines.speaker: Bikash
lines.native: म पनि खै। जिन्दगी छोटो छ, हैन? डिभी परे सबै समस्या सकिन्थ्यो!
lines.roman: ma pani khai. jindagi chhoṭo chha, haina? ḍibhi pare sabai samasyā sakinthyo!
lines.en: Me neither. Life's short, right? If I won the DV lottery, all my problems would be over!

lines.speaker: Rojina
lines.native: हाहा, सपना देख्न छोड, चिया खाऊ। सेलाइसक्यो।
lines.roman: hāhā, sapanā dekhna chhoḍa, chiyā khāu. selāisakyo.
lines.en: Haha, stop dreaming and drink your tea. It's gone cold.

culture:
"Should I go abroad?" is *the* conversation of young Nepal. Hundreds of thousands of young people leave each year — students to **Australia, Japan, the UK, Canada and the US**, workers to the **Gulf states and Malaysia** — and almost every family has someone **विदेशमा**. Friends talk about it openly: visas, IELTS scores, which consultancy to trust, whether it's worth it. Those who stay often aim for a secure government job through **लोक सेवा**, the civil-service exam, which people prepare for for years. The US **DV lottery** (डिभी) is so popular that "डिभी पर्‍यो!" is instantly understood.

Talking about regret, Nepalis tend to the philosophical. **के गर्ने?** 'what can you do?', **भाग्यमा जे छ, त्यही हुन्छ** 'what's written in your fate will happen' and **भइसक्यो, अब के गर्ने** close a sad topic gently, and friends will usually change the subject (often to tea) rather than dwell on it. Giving advice with **म तिमी भए…** is normal among friends; to an older person, soften it: **म भए त… तर तपाईंलाई थाहा छ** 'if it were me… but you know best'. Parents, meanwhile, have their own 'if only': बिहे गरेको भए हुन्थ्यो… 'if only you'd get married…'.

lessons.title: Dreaming out loud

tip.title: I'd love to… : -ने रहर छ
tip.body:
- **मलाई** + verb-**ने** + **रहर छ** — 'I'd love to…': मलाई संसार **घुम्ने रहर** छ.
- Ask a friend: तिम्रो **रहर** के हो?
- 'One day I'll…': **कुनै दिन** + future: कुनै दिन म आफ्नै पसल **खोल्छु**.
- A dream comes true: रहर / सपना **पूरा भयो**.

new: कुनै दिन म आफ्नै बिजनेस खोल्छु।

sentences.native: मलाई संसार घुम्ने रहर छ।
sentences.roman: malāi sansār ghumne rahar chha.
sentences.en: I'd love to travel the world.

sentences.native: तिम्रो रहर के हो, भन न।
sentences.roman: timro rahar ke ho, bhana na.
sentences.en: What's your dream? Go on, tell me.

sentences.native: मेरो रहर आफ्नै पसल खोल्ने हो।
sentences.roman: mero rahar āphnai pasal kholne ho.
sentences.en: My dream is to open my own shop.

sentences.native: कुनै दिन म पनि सगरमाथा चढ्छु।
sentences.roman: kunai din ma pani Sagarmāthā chaḍhchhu.
sentences.en: One day I'll climb Everest too.

sentences.native: उसको डाक्टर बन्ने सपना पूरा भयो।
sentences.roman: usko ḍākṭar banne sapanā purā bhayo.
sentences.en: His dream of becoming a doctor came true.

sentences.native: बिजनेस खोल्न धेरै पैसा चाहिन्छ।
sentences.roman: bijnes kholna dherai paisā chāhinchha.
sentences.en: You need a lot of money to start a business.

sentences.native: मलाई गाडी चलाउन सिक्ने रहर छ।
sentences.roman: malāi gāḍi chalāuna sikne rahar chha.
sentences.en: I'd love to learn to drive.

sentences.native: कुनै दिन हामी सँगै संसार घुम्छौँ, है?
sentences.roman: kunai din hāmi saṃgai sansār ghumchhauṃ, hai?
sentences.en: One day we'll travel the world together, won't we?

sentences.native: आमाको रहर पूरा गर्न म घर बनाउँदै छु।
sentences.roman: āmāko rahar purā garna ma ghar banāundai chhu.
sentences.en: I'm building a house to make Mum's dream come true.

tip.title: Would: -थेँ, -थ्यौ, -थ्यो
tip.body:
- Not true now: if-clause in **-ए** + result in the **'would' form**: पैसा **भए** घर **किन्थेँ**.
- म **गर्थेँ** · तिमी **गर्थ्यौ** · ऊ **गर्थ्यो** · तपाईं **गर्नुहुन्थ्यो**; vowel stems **जान्थेँ, आउँथेँ**.
- Negative: **गर्दिनथेँ**, गर्दैनथ्यौ, गर्दैनथ्यो.
- Advice: **म तिमी भए…** 'if I were you…'.

sentences.native: मसँग पैसा भए म पोखरामा घर किन्थेँ।
sentences.roman: masaṃga paisā bhae ma Pokharāmā ghar kintheṃ.
sentences.en: If I had the money, I'd buy a house in Pokhara.

sentences.native: म धनी भए दिनहुँ घुम्थेँ।
sentences.roman: ma dhani bhae dinahuṃ ghumtheṃ.
sentences.en: If I were rich, I'd travel every day.

sentences.native: म तिमी भए यो जागिर लिन्थेँ।
sentences.roman: ma timi bhae yo jāgir lintheṃ.
sentences.en: If I were you, I'd take this job.

sentences.native: तिमी धनी भए के गर्थ्यौ?
sentences.roman: timi dhani bhae ke garthyau?
sentences.en: What would you do if you were rich?

sentences.native: गाडी भए हामी आजै पोखरा जान्थ्यौँ।
sentences.roman: gāḍi bhae hāmi ājai Pokharā jānthyauṃ.
sentences.en: If we had a car, we'd go to Pokhara today.

sentences.native: आमा यहाँ भए धेरै खुसी हुनुहुन्थ्यो।
sentences.roman: āmā yahāṃ bhae dherai khusi hunuhunthyo.
sentences.en: If Mum were here, she'd be so happy.

sentences.native: म भए त्यति महँगो फोन किन्दिनथेँ।
sentences.roman: ma bhae tyati mahaṃgo phon kindinatheṃ.
sentences.en: If it were me, I wouldn't buy such an expensive phone.

sentences.native: यो सम्भव भए धेरै राम्रो हुन्थ्यो।
sentences.roman: yo sambhab bhae dherai rāmro hunthyo.
sentences.en: If this were possible, it would be great.

sentences.native: करोड रुपैयाँ पाए म आधा आमालाई दिन्थेँ।
sentences.roman: karoḍ rupaiyāṃ pāe ma ādhā āmālāi dintheṃ.
sentences.en: If I got ten million rupees, I'd give half to Mum.

sentences.native: ऊ गरिब भए पनि धेरै खुसी छ।
sentences.roman: u garib bhae pani dherai khusi chha.
sentences.en: Even though he's poor, he's very happy.

tip.title: Should have / would have
tip.body:
- 'If I had…, I would have…': **-एको भए** … **-ने थियो**: थाहा **भएको भए** आउने **थिएँ**.
- 'I should have…': **-नुपर्ने थियो** — मैले भन्**नुपर्ने थियो**.
- 'I shouldn't have…': **-नु हुँदैनथ्यो** — भन्**नु हुँदैनथ्यो**.
- 'I regret it': **मलाई पछुतो लाग्यो**.

sentences.native: मैले त्यो जागिर छोडेको भए अहिले विदेशमा हुने थिएँ।
sentences.roman: maile tyo jāgir chhoḍeko bhae ahile bidesmā hune thieṃ.
sentences.en: If I'd quit that job, I'd be abroad now.

sentences.native: चाँडो भनेको भए म पनि टिकट बुक गर्ने थिएँ।
sentences.roman: chāṃḍo bhaneko bhae ma pani ṭikaṭ buk garne thieṃ.
sentences.en: If you'd told me sooner, I'd have booked a ticket too.

sentences.native: मैले अझ धेरै पढ्नुपर्ने थियो।
sentences.roman: maile ajha dherai paḍhnuparne thiyo.
sentences.en: I should have studied harder.

sentences.native: तिमीले मलाई पहिल्यै भन्नुपर्ने थियो नि!
sentences.roman: timile malāi pahilyai bhannuparne thiyo ni!
sentences.en: You should have told me earlier!

sentences.native: मैले उसलाई त्यसो भन्नु हुँदैनथ्यो।
sentences.roman: maile usalāi tyaso bhannu hundainathyo.
sentences.en: I shouldn't have said that to her.

sentences.native: पहिल्यै थाहा भएको भए म आउने थिइनँ।
sentences.roman: pahilyai thāhā bhaeko bhae ma āune thiinaṃ.
sentences.en: If I'd known beforehand, I wouldn't have come.

sentences.native: त्यो मौका गुमाएकोमा मलाई अहिले पनि पछुतो लाग्छ।
sentences.roman: tyo maukā gumāekomā malāi ahile pani pachhuto lāgchha.
sentences.en: I still regret missing that chance.

sentences.native: उसले पढाइ छोड्यो, अहिले पछुताउँदै छ।
sentences.roman: usle paḍhāi chhoḍyo, ahile pachhutāundai chha.
sentences.en: He dropped out of his studies and now he's regretting it.

sentences.native: अब पछुताएर के गर्ने?
sentences.roman: aba pachhutāera ke garne?
sentences.en: What's the point of regretting it now?

tip.title: I wish: भए हुन्थ्यो
tip.body:
- Now / future: verb in **-ए** + **हुन्थ्यो**: तिमी यहाँ **भए हुन्थ्यो** 'I wish you were here'.
- Negative: **न-…-ए**: पानी **नपरे** हुन्थ्यो 'I hope it doesn't rain'.
- Past: **-एको भए हुन्थ्यो**: म पनि **गएको** भए हुन्थ्यो 'I wish I'd gone too'.
- Just the sigh: पहिल्यै थाहा भएको भए!

sentences.native: आज बिदा भए हुन्थ्यो।
sentences.roman: āja bidā bhae hunthyo.
sentences.en: I wish today were a holiday.

sentences.native: तिमी पनि हामीसँग आए हुन्थ्यो।
sentences.roman: timi pani hāmisaṃga āe hunthyo.
sentences.en: I wish you'd come with us too.

sentences.native: भोलि पानी नपरे हुन्थ्यो।
sentences.roman: bholi pāni napare hunthyo.
sentences.en: I hope it doesn't rain tomorrow.

sentences.native: मैले पनि सानैदेखि नेपाली सिकेको भए हुन्थ्यो।
sentences.roman: maile pani sānaidekhi nepāli sikeko bhae hunthyo.
sentences.en: I wish I'd learned Nepali as a child too.

sentences.native: मैले त्यो कुरा नभनेको भए हुन्थ्यो।
sentences.roman: maile tyo kurā nabhaneko bhae hunthyo.
sentences.en: I wish I hadn't said that.

sentences.native: चिट्ठा परे हुन्थ्यो!
sentences.roman: chiṭṭhā pare hunthyo!
sentences.en: If only I won the lottery!

sentences.native: हिजो तिमी पनि पार्टीमा भए हुन्थ्यो।
sentences.roman: hijo timi pani pārṭimā bhae hunthyo.
sentences.en: I wish you had been at the party yesterday too.

sentences.native: भाग्यले साथ दिएन, के गर्ने?
sentences.roman: bhāgyale sāth diena, ke garne?
sentences.en: Luck wasn't on my side — what can you do?

sentences.native: उसको भाग्य राम्रो रहेछ, डिभी चिट्ठा पर्‍यो।
sentences.roman: usko bhāgya rāmro rahechha, ḍibhi chiṭṭhā paryo.
sentences.en: Turns out he was lucky — he won the DV lottery.

sentences.native: जिन्दगी छोटो छ, मन लागेको काम गर।
sentences.roman: jindagi chhoṭo chha, man lāgeko kām gara.
sentences.en: Life is short — do what you want to do.

sentences.native: उसले अस्ट्रेलियामा पढ्न छात्रवृत्ति पायो।
sentences.roman: usle Asṭreliyāmā paḍhna chhātrabritti pāyo.
sentences.en: She got a scholarship to study in Australia.

sentences.native: म लोक सेवाको तयारी गर्दै छु।
sentences.roman: ma lok sewāko tayāri gardai chhu.
sentences.en: I'm preparing for the civil-service exam.

sentences.native: विदेश र नेपालको जिन्दगीमा धेरै फरक छ।
sentences.roman: bides ra nepālko jindagimā dherai pharak chha.
sentences.en: There's a big difference between life abroad and life in Nepal.

sentences.native: बुढेसकालमा म पोखरामा बस्न चाहन्छु।
sentences.roman: buḍheskālmā ma Pokharāmā basna chāhanchhu.
sentences.en: In my old age I want to live in Pokhara.

sentences.native: काठमाडौंमा बाँच्न धेरै महँगो भयो।
sentences.roman: Kāṭhmāḍauṃmā bāṃchna dherai mahaṃgo bhayo.
sentences.en: Living in Kathmandu has become very expensive.

sentences.native: ऊ आए पनि नआए पनि के फरक पर्छ र?
sentences.roman: u āe pani naāe pani ke pharak parchha ra?
sentences.en: Whether he comes or not, what difference does it make?

sentences.native: लोक सेवा पास गरेको भए जिन्दगी सजिलो हुन्थ्यो।
sentences.roman: lok sewā pās gareko bhae jindagi sajilo hunthyo.
sentences.en: If I'd passed the civil-service exam, life would be easier.

sentences.native: मलाई उसलाई मन पर्छ भन्ने आँट आएन।
sentences.roman: malāi usalāi man parchha bhanne āṃṭ āena.
sentences.en: I didn't have the nerve to tell her I liked her.

sentences.native: नडराऊ, तिमी सक्छौ।
sentences.roman: naḍarāu, timi sakchhau.
sentences.en: Don't be scared — you can do it.

sentences.native: म जागिर छोड्न डराएँ।
sentences.roman: ma jāgir chhoḍna ḍarāeṃ.
sentences.en: I was scared to quit my job.

sentences.native: ऊ हवाईजहाज चढ्न डराउँछ।
sentences.roman: u hawāijahāj chaḍhna ḍarāunchha.
sentences.en: He's scared of flying.

sentences.native: आँट भए जे पनि सम्भव छ।
sentences.roman: āṃṭ bhae je pani sambhab chha.
sentences.en: With enough nerve, anything is possible.

sentences.native: आँट गरेको भए आज म आफ्नै बिजनेस चलाउँथेँ।
sentences.roman: āṃṭ gareko bhae āja ma āphnai bijnes chalāuntheṃ.
sentences.en: If I'd dared, I'd be running my own business today.

sentences.native: बस छुटिसक्यो, अब के गर्ने? अर्कोलाई पर्खौँ।
sentences.roman: bas chhuṭisakyo, aba ke garne? arkolāi parkhauṃ.
sentences.en: The bus has already gone — what can you do? Let's wait for the next one.
